response.sql: WITH per_acct AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, num_transactions, CAST(total_volume AS REAL) / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS volume_share FROM per_acct ORDER BY volume_share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Total volume sums trans.amount over all rows regardless of type (including the undocumented VYBER type), as the request states.
The share denominator is the total volume across all accounts that remain after dropping transactions with no matching account or district (not the unfiltered trans total).
Ties in share are broken arbitrarily.
